title: "InstallingShiny"
output: html_document
date: "2026-11-23"
---
```{r}
# 1. Point R at the library where you installed Rcpp.
#    Skip this line if you installed it into the default AppData library.
#.libPaths(c("C:/Rlibs", .libPaths()))

# 2. Confirm Rcpp loads
library(Rcpp)

# 3. Clear out any half-installed shiny or lock folders
for (lib in .libPaths()) {
  unlink(list.files(lib, pattern = "^(shiny|00LOCK)", full.names = TRUE), recursive = TRUE)
}

# 4. Download Shiny from CRAN website and unzip in the AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.5 folder
# 4.5 Restart R

# 5. Test it
library(shiny)
```
